title: Disabling NOC via the settings row while the panel is on leaves it stuck rendering — D cannot dismiss it
detail: Sequence: press D (overlay_on=true), open settings, toggle 'NOC PANEL (D)' OFF (noc_enabled=false; overlay_on never cleared — the only assignments are boot false at :296 and the gated flip at :894). The draw gate at :635 checks only overlay_on, so the panel keeps rendering while the feature is 'disabled', and effect_overlay's noc_enabled gate blocks the D press that could dismiss it. Recoverable only by re-enabling the row.
recommended_fix: In the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case, when the flag flips to false also set app.overlay_on = false (or gate the draw/scan on noc_enabled && overlay_on) so disabling the feature guarantees zero pixels.
